description: She wears a deep red floor length gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow length sleeves. Fine gold woven trim borders the neckline, sleeves, hem and central opening, where a cream underdress is visible. A gold brown shoulder wrap with red patterned edges rests around her forearms and hangs down both sides. A decorated belt gathers the waist, and a small round pendant hangs at her upper chest. Her hands rest together in front and brown leather shoes show below the hem. Her head is bare.
